asr.full_text: Hello World, This is Madan Raj from Codefeature So in this video I am going to talk about Whenever any programmer has a problem Who does he call? Keep watching this video till the end You will get to know after watching the title But still, make excitement from it So in this video I will talk about What is Stack Overflow? How can we solve our problem by going about Stack Overflow How to solve your problem on Stack Overflow and how to solve other's problem Ok, I am Madan Raj, Let's start the video Music The best way to work in real life is having such an understanding that only the programmer will understand. Alright let us talk in detail about Stack Overflow. Imagine yourself as a programmer Say that you are a programmer In a project, theree what kind of a programmer you are. When we create a particular project, we get into many technical problems like, forgetting certain functions, keywords etc.. and we tend to make mistake in our programming. Actually, we don't just get error instead we are actually forgetting some of the concepts Not only error as a concept should be understood and then have forgotten. For example, how to use an error or bubble sort algorithm that I do not know. If I want to learn I can start teaching this on Stackoverflow, I mean I can clear my doubts. Because even if it is programming, I cannot learn from them. I can clear our doubts the programming from the website we have to learn our problem and problem solved with clear here you can see I have a doubt so I went to stack overflow on the website stack overflow is not a common websites where in you can get the answer to your problem these kind of website is most known when I have a problem or something of that sort. There are various websites like this but this one is the most famous. For example, if I had a Problem So I decided on the Sac Overflow website and on the website, the questions will get answered like how I search for them But as I got answers I thought, I can answer other person's questions too. If I can answer some questions, can say it i can answer their question if I say it so many other people can say it and there many answers will be there which one is wrong and which one is right how you find it for that voting system is there for example I have a problem so I go to the stackoverflow website there on my website where with an answer in the description. After selecting an answer, I checked the problem and voted for the answer. This way, the vote does not matter whether there is a like or a dislike or or negative or positive It means there will be a vote up or down and the person who will say in the vote will be the first one to vote so most of them are helped by the majority and at the time you join me If you want more help, then you can help them by sending messages or videos on the website like this. To help and donate to charity, if you can help other Programmers. and there is a very good support which every programmer does They help each other so you can give answers to others your answers will also be given with all the options so in that type your answer will be both up and down so this is one thing In Stackoverflow we can do one more thing as we are given a lot of answers then we can give a lot of votes and my answers is in good concept If the votes amount high That image can be made and we can do a job not just with that image I can make my profile and apply for job on stack overflow But it takes reputation And by go into jobs list also work in the stackoverflow but also this is a reputation So we go to the jobs and in the private location and can perform our job there but for the job it will be a famous or don't for the problem solving people stackoverflow must be famous Hope you understood that the Stack Overflow works How you can find your answers how can you provide your answers thats it for this video thank you for watching I am Madan Raj If you like this Video, Please Like Subscribe this channel See you in my next video with an interesting topic
